gloss: volcanic smoke; plume of smoke from a volcano

definitions.gloss: volcanic smoke; plume of smoke from a volcano
definitions.explanation: Smoke, ash, and gases emitted from a volcanic crater. Commonly seen in news reports about volcanic activity in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{噴煙|ふんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Smoke is rising from the volcano.

examples.japanese: {噴煙|ふんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{三千|さんぜん}→三千：00985_sanzen⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The volcanic plume reached a height of about 3,000 meters.

examples.japanese: {桜島|さくらじま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{噴煙|ふんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At Sakurajima, volcanic plumes are observed on a daily basis.

notes:
FORMS:
{噴|ふん} (to spew) + {煙|えん} (smoke)

USAGE:
Frequently appears in weather and disaster reports. Japan has over 100 active volcanoes, so this term is regularly seen in news broadcasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {噴煙|ふんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: volcanic smoke rises
- {噴煙|ふんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to emit volcanic smoke
- {噴煙|ふんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: height of the plume
- {噴煙|ふんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}される→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: volcanic smoke is observed

- ⟦{火山灰|かざんばい}→火山灰：19412_kazanbai⟧: volcanic ash
